purpose: Provide an executable sampled scalar-burn MassState evolution with constant CoM and full inertia under a dedicated fixture-local model identity.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted the recommended fixture-local scalar-burn constant-geometry choice. The dedicated identity limits the approximation to this executable R0 profile. Product and Legacy runtime APIs are absent.

expected_facts.claim: Independent 80-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations subtract the exact interval consumption from positive committed mass and copy the CoM coordinate and full inertia tensor exactly into a positive candidate.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Identity, tick and geometry-copy relationships are exact; mass formulas use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The current sample remains visible through the interval, the complete candidate commits at valid_until_tick, and next-boundary Closure geometry plus constant-inertia rotational dynamics remain continuous while translational specific force reflects the new mass.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Visibility and commit identities are exact; consumer formulas use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Interval partitioning preserves final state, while invalid identities, nonpositive masses, depletion, mass gain, early visibility, CoM drift and inertia scaling fail directly.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Rejection and equivalence identities are exact; tolerance never clamps mass or changes geometry policy.

acceptance: The dedicated model identity fixes scalar subtraction, candidate positivity, constant CoM/full inertia and next-boundary publication
The Decimal reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Fuel geometry, dry mass, depletion handling, configuration changes, canonical assets and product contracts remain outside this slice
